what: Where the hand enters, a circle twice the button width grows over 1.25s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) and fills the background, and when the hand moves inside the button the circle’s center follows it over .5s. On exit the circle is pushed 25% further past the edge it left from and shrinks over .45s. Meanwhile the background swells to 1.065×1.095 on a spring curve (.34,2.27,.64,1) over .4s, and presses down to .955×.925 on click. Text color switches to the on-fill color over .25s.
needs: CustomEase (curve as numbers — expo.out if absent)

options.grow · shrink · follow: Circle grow, shrink and follow durations (s), default 1.25 · .45 · .5
options.[data-fx-part=circle]: (if any) slot that holds the circles — created if missing
options.--fx-fill · --fx-hover-ink: Text color over the circle fill, default --kf-ink·--kf-bg
options.--fx-border: Inner 1px border color of the background (outline button), default none

use: Your button text here
